title: The unfair sex.
html_source:
A play on the term “the fair sex”.

fair sex
n.
usage: This term, though rarely used today, is sometimes perceived as patronizing.
—n.
Older Use: Sometimes Offensive. women collectively.

anchor.prefix:
the harm out of it. Shabby genteel. She used to be a tasty dresser. Lines round her mouth. Only a year or so older than Molly. 

 See the eye that woman gave her, passing. Cruel.
